filing.summary: Clerk FAQ directs attorney filings through the ePortal. Upload individual pleadings separately. Ordinary paper follow-up is not required, except originals required by law/rule; see additional FAQ for its list.

proposed_orders.summary: Clerk FAQ describes attachment with a pleading or delivery to clerk/judge. Individual judge instructions separately prescribe portal or email routes and editable formats; preserve these source-specific instructions rather than treating the generic FAQ as a universal order-submission rule.

filing_status.summary: Check portal notifications and My Filings status, then SCORSS for accepted records. FAQ distinguishes receipt from processing and warns processing may take three days; it states a five-business-day pending-queue correction period. These are the clerk page’s statements, not independently reconciled legal deadlines.

summons.summary: Additional FAQ directs e-filing the unexecuted summons with payment; attorney retrieves the issued image through SCORSS. Return of service is e-filed.

chambers_communications.summary: Civil inquiries: published clerk number, option 5; general inquiries via linked portal/contact forms. Portal technical support is separate from clerk contacts. Include a self-addressed stamped envelope when requesting return of an original document.
